name: Alveo U280 (xcu280 / xcvu37p)
note: per-SLR capacities are approximate device totals divided by 3; replace with usable area after removing the shell (report_utilization -slr on an empty design gives the exact numbers)
memory_note: HBM is attached at the bottom of SLR0; DDR4 controllers sit in SLR0/SLR1. 'axi' edges are anchored to SLR0 by default.
